direct_prompt_injection.description: The prompt appears to attempt to override the model's prior instructions.

system_prompt_extraction.description: The prompt appears to request hidden system instructions or prompt content.

role_manipulation.description: The prompt appears to assign a new identity, role, or unrestricted mode.

tool_manipulation.description: The prompt appears to request potentially unsafe tool or action use.

obfuscated_injection.description: The prompt contains obfuscation signals that may conceal suspicious instructions.

policy_bypass.description: The prompt appears to ask for bypassing or disabling safeguards.
